---
title: "POSENRICH: position-level enrichment of CAAS detections"
subtitle: "`r paste0('Trait: ', params$traitname)`"
date: "`r format(Sys.time(), '%d %B %Y')`"
author: "PhyloPhere pipeline"
output:
  html_document:
    theme: flatly
    toc: true
    toc_float:
      collapsed: false
    code_folding: hide
    df_print: paged
    self_contained: true
    mathjax: null
    md_extensions: "-tex_math_dollars"
params:
  universe_dir: NULL           # universe.tsv.gz and universe_manifest.json
  registry_dir: NULL           # registry manifest (gene-list check) and coverage
  characterization_dir: NULL   # collection_summary.tsv, ranking_summary.tsv, universe_summary.tsv
  accumulation_dir: NULL       # accumulation_{all,top,bottom}_results.csv (level 1)
  within_gene_dir: NULL        # within_gene_results.tsv, within_gene_by_gene.tsv (level 2)
  proximity_dir: NULL          # proximity_{protein,genomic}_summary.tsv, proximity_protein_{hits,by_gene}.tsv
  traitname: "trait"
  fdr_levels: NULL             # BH levels, comma-separated; explicit override, otherwise report_settings.json, then 0.05,0.1,0.15
  table_rows: 2000             # rows of a table kept in the HTML; the complete tables are published as TSV/CSV
  detail_terms: 50             # terms whose per-gene rows are embedded (the most significant ones)
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
suppressPackageStartupMessages({library(dplyr); library(readr); library(DT); library(jsonlite); library(ggplot2)})

theme_set(
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(axis.title.y = element_text(margin = ggplot2::margin(l = 20, r = 20)),
        axis.title.x = element_text(margin = ggplot2::margin(t = 12)),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0), legend.position = "right")
)

# Shared table helpers (lazy-mounted DataTables). The file sits next to the report in a process work directory
# and in ENRICHMENT/local/src when the report is rendered in place.
.helpers <- c("src/report_presentation.R", "../../ENRICHMENT/local/src/report_presentation.R")
.helpers <- .helpers[file.exists(.helpers)]
if (!length(.helpers)) stop("report_presentation.R not found next to the report")
source(.helpers[1])
.style <- c("src/report_style.R", "../../TRAIT_ANALYSIS/local/src/report_style.R")
.style <- .style[file.exists(.style)]
if (!length(.style)) stop("report_style.R not found next to the report")
source(.style[1])

settings_file <- if (!is.null(params$universe_dir)) file.path(dirname(params$universe_dir),'report_settings.json') else ''
saved_settings <- if (file.exists(settings_file)) fromJSON(settings_file,simplifyVector=FALSE) else NULL
if (!is.null(saved_settings) && !identical(saved_settings$schema,'phylophere.posenrich_report.v1')) stop('Invalid POSENRICH report settings')
fdr_levels <- sort(as.numeric(strsplit(as.character(if (!is.null(params$fdr_levels)) params$fdr_levels else
                  if (length(saved_settings$fdr_levels)) paste(unlist(saved_settings$fdr_levels), collapse = ",") else "0.05,0.1,0.15"), ",")[[1]]))
max_rows <- as.integer(params$table_rows)
stopifnot(length(fdr_levels) >= 1L, all(is.finite(fdr_levels)), all(fdr_levels > 0), all(fdr_levels <= 1), !anyDuplicated(fdr_levels),
          length(max_rows) == 1L, !is.na(max_rows), max_rows > 0L)

component_file <- function(path, name) {
  if (is.null(path) || !length(path) || is.na(path) || !nzchar(path)) "" else file.path(path, name)
}
read_json_file <- function(path, name) {
  f <- component_file(path, name)
  if (file.exists(f)) fromJSON(f, simplifyVector = FALSE) else NULL
}
read_table <- function(path, name, ...) {
  f <- component_file(path, name)
  if (!file.exists(f)) return(NULL)
  d <- read_tsv(f, show_col_types = FALSE, na = character(), col_types = cols(.default = col_character()))
  ids <- c('Gene','gene','collection_id','term_id','term_label','description','metric','scope','id','source','note',
           'status','evaluation_status','exclusion_cause','denominator_definition','denominator_is')
  numeric_columns <- grep('^(n_|N_|prop_|frequency_|mean_score_|intensity_|positives_|expected_)|^(p|q|statistic|Position|position|residual|denominator|proportion|median_distance|mean_distance|coverage_proportion|min|max|median|q25|q75|alpha|fpr|eligible|n_positions_gene)$',names(d),value=TRUE)
  for (column in setdiff(names(d), ids)) {
    if (column %in% numeric_columns) d[[column]] <- parse_double(d[[column]],na=c('', 'NA'))
    else if (nrow(d)) d[[column]] <- type_convert(tibble(value=d[[column]]), na=c('', 'NA'), col_types=cols(value=col_guess()))$value
  }
  d
}

fmt_int <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), "NA", format(round(x), big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE))
fmt_prop <- function(x, digits = 4) ifelse(is.na(x), "NA", formatC(x, format = "f", digits = digits))

# BH levels and classes. A q falls in the strictest level it is below ("q<0.05", ...), "ns" above the loosest level or without q; "BH"
# below stands for a q under the loosest level. Hits per level count the q below that level (cumulative).
bh_levels <- fdr_levels
bh_tok <- vapply(bh_levels, format, "", scientific = FALSE); bh_labels <- paste0("q<", bh_tok)   # strictest first
bh_hits <- function(q) vapply(bh_levels, function(x) if (any(is.finite(q))) sum(q < x, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_integer_, integer(1))
bh_any <- function(q) !is.na(q) & q < max(bh_levels)
bh_label <- function(q) {
  out <- rep(NA_character_, length(q))
  for (i in rev(seq_along(bh_levels))) out[which(q < bh_levels[i])] <- bh_labels[i]
  out
}
bh_factor <- function(q) factor(ifelse(is.na(bh_label(q)), "ns", bh_label(q)), levels = c("ns", rev(bh_labels)))
bh_colours <- setNames(unname(report_bh_colours(paste0("<", bh_tok))), c("ns", bh_labels))
bh_counts_text <- function(q) paste(sprintf("%s %s", bh_labels, fmt_int(vapply(bh_levels, function(l) sum(!is.na(q) & q < l), 1L))), collapse = ", ")

# A component that did not run is stated, never read as an empty result.
unavailable <- function(what, why) cat(sprintf("**%s: not available.** %s\n\n", what, why))

# Tables beyond max_rows keep the first rows (callers order them by relevance) and say where the rest is.
emit_table <- function(df, source, sci_cols = NULL, caption = NULL) {
  n <- nrow(df)
  if (n > max_rows) {
    cat(sprintf("Showing the first %s of %s rows; the complete table is `%s`.\n\n", fmt_int(max_rows), fmt_int(n), source))
    df <- head(df, max_rows)
  }
  report_emit(report_table(df, caption = caption, sci_cols = sci_cols))
}

# A plot is embedded as a PNG (the report stays one self-contained file and the plots do not need a JavaScript library).
emit_plot <- function(p, height = 4.5, width = 10) {
  f <- tempfile(fileext = ".png")
  ggplot2::ggsave(f, p, width = width, height = height, dpi = 110, bg = "white", limitsize = FALSE)
  cat(sprintf('<img src="data:image/png;base64,%s" style="max-width:100%%;" />\n\n', base64enc::base64encode(f)))
  unlink(f)
}

verify_component <- function(path, name) {
  f <- component_file(path,name)
  if (!file.exists(f)) return(invisible(NULL))
  m <- fromJSON(f,simplifyVector=FALSE)
  if (is.null(m$outputs) || is.null(names(m$outputs))) stop('Unverified POSENRICH component; regenerate it')
  for (file in names(m$outputs)) {
    p <- file.path(path,file)
    if (basename(file)!=file || !file.exists(p) || (is.list(m$outputs[[file]]) && file.info(p)$size != m$outputs[[file]]$size)) stop(paste('Changed POSENRICH artifact:',p))
  }
}
verify_component(params$universe_dir,'universe_manifest.json')
verify_component(params$registry_dir,'manifest.json')
verify_component(params$characterization_dir,'characterization_manifest.json')
verify_component(params$within_gene_dir,'within_gene_manifest.json')
verify_component(params$proximity_dir,'proximity_manifest.json')

universe_manifest <- read_json_file(params$universe_dir, "universe_manifest.json")
registry_manifest <- read_json_file(params$registry_dir, "manifest.json")
wg_manifest <- read_json_file(params$within_gene_dir, "within_gene_manifest.json")
prox_manifest <- read_json_file(params$proximity_dir, "proximity_manifest.json")

universe_file <- component_file(params$universe_dir, "universe.tsv.gz")
universe <- if (file.exists(universe_file)) {
  read_tsv(universe_file, show_col_types = FALSE,
           na = character(), col_types = cols(gene = col_character(), position = col_integer(), nd = col_integer(),
                            observed_positive = col_integer(), observed_top = col_integer(),
                            observed_bottom = col_integer()))
} else NULL
n_u <- if (is.null(universe)) NA_integer_ else nrow(universe)

accumulation <- lapply(c(all = "all", top = "top", bottom = "bottom"), function(d) {
  f <- component_file(params$accumulation_dir, sprintf("accumulation_%s_results.csv", d))
  if (!file.exists(f) && !is.null(params$accumulation_dir)) {
    candidates <- list.files(params$accumulation_dir, pattern=paste0('^accumulation_',d,'_results[.]csv$'), recursive=TRUE, full.names=TRUE)
    if (length(candidates)>1) stop('Duplicate accumulation direction')
    if (length(candidates)==1) f <- candidates
  }
  if (file.exists(f)) {
    meta <- fromJSON(paste0(f,'.manifest.json'), simplifyVector=FALSE)
    if (is.null(meta$outputs[[basename(f)]]) || (is.list(meta$outputs[[basename(f)]]) && file.info(f)$size != meta$outputs[[basename(f)]]$size)) stop('Changed accumulation results')
    d <- read_csv(f, show_col_types=FALSE, na=character(), col_types=cols(.default=col_character()))
    for (column in setdiff(names(d),c('Gene','status'))) d[[column]] <- parse_double(d[[column]],na=c('NA',''))
    d
  } else NULL
})
wg_results <- read_table(params$within_gene_dir, "within_gene_results.tsv")
wg_by_gene <- read_table(params$within_gene_dir, "within_gene_by_gene.tsv",
                         col_types = cols_only(collection_id = col_character(), term_id = col_character(),
                                               gene = col_character(), n_positions_gene = col_integer(),
                                               n_members = col_integer(), positives_gene = col_double(),
                                               positives_members = col_double(), expected_members = col_double(),
                                               residual = col_double(), eligible = col_integer(),
                                               excluded_reason = col_character()))
```

# Scope and state of the components

A position is **positive** when its canonical score of convergent amino acid substitution (CAAS) is greater than 0. Every question refers to positive positions and to sets of positions (layers: protein domains, conserved regions, selection calls, site lists). The unit is a position of the trimmed CAAS alignment, `(Gene, Position)`, zero-based. A **layer** is a source of annotation and a **term** is one of its sets of positions.

```{r states, results='asis'}
wg_state <- if (!is.null(wg_results)) "available" else "not available"
acc_present <- names(accumulation)[!vapply(accumulation, is.null, logical(1))]
states <- data.frame(
  Component = c("Universe", "Registry", "Characterization", "Level 1 (genes)", "Level 2 (terms within genes)", "Proximity"),
  State = c(
    if (is.null(universe)) "not available" else "available",
    if (is.null(registry_manifest)) "not available" else "available",
    if (is.null(read_table(params$characterization_dir, "collection_summary.tsv"))) "not available" else "available",
    if (length(acc_present) == 3L) "available" else if (length(acc_present)) paste("partial:", paste(acc_present, collapse = ", ")) else "not available",
    wg_state,
    if (is.null(read_table(params$proximity_dir, "proximity_protein_summary.tsv"))) "not available" else "available (descriptive)"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
report_emit(report_table(states))
```

```{r prep, include=FALSE}
# Every table and number used by the sections below is prepared here, so that each section only presents.
n_cycles <- if (!is.null(wg_manifest$counts$n_null_cycles)) wg_manifest$counts$n_null_cycles else NA
min_genes <- if (!is.null(wg_manifest$parameters$min_genes)) wg_manifest$parameters$min_genes else NA
p_floor <- if (is.na(n_cycles)) NA else 1 / (n_cycles + 1)
states_tbl <- read_table(params$characterization_dir, "universe_summary.tsv")
coll_sum <- read_table(params$characterization_dir, "collection_summary.tsv")
rank_sum <- read_table(params$characterization_dir, "ranking_summary.tsv")
n_positive_total <- if (!is.null(universe)) sum(universe$observed_positive) else if (!is.null(states_tbl)) {
  v <- states_tbl$n_positions[states_tbl$evaluation_status == "detected_positive"]; if (length(v)) v[1] else NA
} else NA

# Level 1: the headline model is the empirical count test (calibrated with the null cycles). The hypergeometric model
# (uniform opportunity) is a reference; it leads only for a direction without a compatible null.
K_of <- c(all = if (is.null(universe)) NA else sum(universe$observed_positive),
          top = if (is.null(universe)) NA else sum(universe$observed_top),
          bottom = if (is.null(universe)) NA else sum(universe$observed_bottom))
level1 <- lapply(accumulation[acc_present], function(d) {
  emp <- any(is.finite(d$EmpiricalQ))
  d$head_p <- if (emp) d$EmpiricalP else d$PValue
  d$head_q <- if (emp) d$EmpiricalQ else d$QValue
  d$head_mean <- if (emp) d$EmpiricalMeanNull else d$MeanNull
  d$head_model <- if (emp) "empirical" else "hypergeometric"
  d
})
level1_cycles <- unique(unlist(lapply(level1, function(d) d$N_cycles[is.finite(d$N_cycles)])))
level1_floor <- if (length(level1_cycles) == 1L) 1 / (level1_cycles + 1) else NA

# Level 2
res <- wg_results
excl <- if (is.null(wg_by_gene)) NULL else wg_by_gene %>% group_by(collection_id, term_id) %>%
  summarise(excluded_no_nonmembers = sum(excluded_reason == "no_nonmembers", na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
ordered <- if (is.null(res)) NULL else res %>% arrange(is.na(p), p, desc(abs(statistic)))
if (!is.null(ordered) && !is.null(excl)) ordered <- ordered %>% left_join(excl, by = c("collection_id", "term_id"))
term_tbl <- if (is.null(ordered)) NULL else ordered %>%
  transmute(Layer = collection_id, Term = term_id, Status = status,
            `Genes with members in U` = n_genes_with_members_in_U, `Genes eligible` = n_genes_eligible,
            `Positions in term (eligible genes)` = n_members_eligible, `Positive positions in term` = positives_members_eligible,
            `Expected positive positions` = expected_positives_members, Statistic = statistic, p = p, q = q,
            `Frequency in term` = frequency_members, `Frequency in rest of genes` = frequency_rest,
            `Frequency difference` = frequency_difference, `Intensity difference` = intensity_difference)

# Proximity
prox_p <- read_table(params$proximity_dir, "proximity_protein_summary.tsv")
prox_g <- read_table(params$proximity_dir, "proximity_genomic_summary.tsv")
prox_hits <- read_table(params$proximity_dir, "proximity_protein_hits.tsv")
prox_gene <- read_table(params$proximity_dir, "proximity_protein_by_gene.tsv")
radii <- unlist(prox_manifest$parameters$radios)
near_radius <- if (length(radii)) max(radii) else 0
coll_rank <- function(x) ifelse(x == "custom", 0L, 1L)
prox_counts <- if (!is.null(prox_hits)) prox_hits %>% group_by(collection_id, term_id) %>%
  summarise(`Overlaps (exact identity)` = sum(relation == "overlap"), `Near positions` = sum(relation == "near"),
            `Genes with an overlap` = n_distinct(Gene[relation == "overlap"]),
            `Genes with a near position` = n_distinct(Gene[relation == "near"]), .groups = "drop") else NULL

# One row per term: what each analysis says about it.
term_view <- NULL
if (!is.null(coll_sum)) {
  term_view <- coll_sum %>% transmute(Layer = collection_id, Term = term_id, `Positions in term` = n_members,
                                      `Positive positions in term` = n_members_positive)
  if (!is.null(res)) term_view <- term_view %>% left_join(
    res %>% transmute(Layer = collection_id, Term = term_id, `Genes eligible` = n_genes_eligible, Statistic = statistic,
                      p = p, q = q, `Frequency difference` = frequency_difference), by = c("Layer", "Term"))
  # Without level-2 results p and q must still exist as (empty) columns; a bare `q` would resolve to base::q().
  if (is.null(res)) term_view <- term_view %>% mutate(`Genes eligible` = NA_integer_, Statistic = NA_real_, p = NA_real_, q = NA_real_,
                                                      `Frequency difference` = NA_real_)
  if (!is.null(prox_p)) {
    evaluated <- paste(prox_p$collection_id, prox_p$term_id)
    pc_ <- if (is.null(prox_counts)) tibble(Layer = character(), Term = character()) else
      prox_counts %>% transmute(Layer = collection_id, Term = term_id, Overlaps = `Overlaps (exact identity)`, `Near positions`)
    term_view <- term_view %>% left_join(pc_, by = c("Layer", "Term")) %>%
      mutate(across(any_of(c("Overlaps", "Near positions")), ~ ifelse(paste(Layer, Term) %in% evaluated, tidyr::replace_na(.x, 0L), NA)))
  }
  term_view <- term_view %>% arrange(is.na(q), q, is.na(p), p, desc(`Positive positions in term`))
}
```

# Summary {#summary}

```{r summary, results='asis'}
l1 <- vapply(acc_present, function(dir) {
  d <- level1[[dir]]
  sprintf("%s: %s of %s tested genes below the loosest BH level (%s)%s", dir, fmt_int(sum(bh_any(d$head_q))), fmt_int(sum(d$status == "tested")), bh_counts_text(d$head_q),
          if (d$head_model[1] == "hypergeometric") " (hypergeometric: no compatible null)" else "")
}, character(1))
cat("- **[Level 1: genes](#level1).** ", if (length(l1)) paste(l1, collapse = "; ") else "not available", ".\n", sep = "")
cat("- **[Level 2: terms](#level2).** ", if (is.null(res)) "not available" else
      sprintf("%s terms evaluated, %s tested, %s below the loosest BH level (%s)", fmt_int(nrow(res)), fmt_int(sum(res$status == "tested")), fmt_int(sum(bh_any(res$q))), bh_counts_text(res$q)), ".\n", sep = "")
cat("- **[Overlaps and proximity](#proximity).** ", if (is.null(prox_hits)) "not available" else
      sprintf("%s positive positions coincide with a member of a term; %s lie within %s residues of one", fmt_int(sum(prox_hits$relation == "overlap")),
              fmt_int(sum(prox_hits$relation == "near")), near_radius), ".\n", sep = "")
cat("- **[By term](#termview)** gathers the three analyses in one row per term. **[Characterization](#characterization)** counts the positive positions by layer", if (!is.null(universe)) sprintf(": %s of %s positions of U are positive", fmt_int(sum(universe$observed_positive)), fmt_int(n_u)), "", ".\n", sep = "")
cat("- **[Appendix](#appendix)**: universe and coverage, BH thresholds, terms not tested and methods.\n\n")
```

# Level 1: genes that accumulate positive positions {#level1}

```{r level1-text, results='asis'}
cat(sprintf("Does a gene hold more positive positions than the null cycles produce? The headline model is the **empirical count test**: `p = (1 + cycles with count >= observed) / (N + 1)`%s. A gene whose observed count is never reached by the null sits at that floor, so genes at the floor tie; the table orders them by observed over expected, which is a description and not extra evidence. Separate BH families for all, top and bottom include every cleaned-background gene with tested positions (genes with no observed positive have p = 1). The hypergeometric model (uniform opportunity over U, conditioned on the observed total) is shown as reference columns and in the appendix; its q-values are not combined with the empirical ones. Neither establishes positive selection or causality.\n\n",
            if (length(level1_cycles) == 1L) sprintf(", N = %s, smallest attainable p = %s", fmt_int(level1_cycles), format(level1_floor, digits = 3)) else ""))
```

```{r level1, results='asis'}
if (!length(acc_present)) {
  unavailable("Level 1", "No `accumulation_<direction>_results.csv` was published: the module ran without level 1.")
} else {
  summary_rows <- do.call(rbind, lapply(acc_present, function(dir) {
    d <- level1[[dir]]
    as.data.frame(c(list(Direction = dir, `Observed positives (K)` = K_of[[dir]], `Genes tested` = sum(d$status == "tested"),
                         Model = d$head_model[1]),
                    setNames(lapply(bh_levels, function(l) sum(!is.na(d$head_q) & d$head_q < l)), paste0("Genes with ", bh_labels)),
                    list(`Smallest q` = if (any(!is.na(d$head_q))) min(d$head_q, na.rm = TRUE) else NA)),
                  check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }))
  cat(sprintf("**Summary by direction** (BH levels: %s)\n\n", paste(bh_labels, collapse = ", ")))
  report_emit(report_table(summary_rows, sci_cols = "Smallest q"))
  cat("\n\n## Genes above the null expectation {.tabset}\n\n")
  for (dir in acc_present) {
    d <- level1[[dir]]
    cat(sprintf("\n### %s\n\n", dir))
    shown <- d %>% filter(ActualCount > head_mean, !is.na(head_q)) %>% arrange(head_p, desc(ActualCount / head_mean), Gene) %>%
      transmute(Gene, `Positions in gene (n_g)` = PoolPositions, `Observed positives` = ActualCount,
                Expected = head_mean, `Observed / expected` = ActualCount / head_mean,
                p = head_p, q = head_q, `BH class` = as.character(bh_factor(head_q)),
                `Hypergeometric expected` = MeanNull, `Hypergeometric p` = PValue, `Hypergeometric q` = QValue)
    cat(sprintf("%s tested genes hold more positive positions than expected (%s model); %s are below the loosest BH level (%s).\n\n",
                fmt_int(nrow(shown)), d$head_model[1], fmt_int(sum(bh_any(shown$q))), bh_counts_text(shown$q)))
    pl <- d %>% filter(ActualCount > 0) %>% mutate(.x = pmax(head_mean, 1e-3))
    if (nrow(pl)) {
      lab <- pl %>% filter(!is.na(head_q)) %>% arrange(head_p, desc(ActualCount)) %>% head(8)
      pp <- ggplot(pl, aes(.x, ActualCount, colour = bh_factor(ifelse(ActualCount > head_mean, head_q, NA_real_)))) +
        geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, colour = "grey60", linetype = "dashed") + geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 1.3) +
        geom_text(data = lab, aes(label = Gene), size = 3, vjust = -0.7, check_overlap = TRUE, show.legend = FALSE) +
        scale_x_log10() + scale_y_log10() +
        scale_colour_manual(values = bh_colours, drop = FALSE, name = "BH class") +
        labs(x = sprintf("Expected positive positions (%s mean; values below 0.001 drawn at 0.001)", d$head_model[1]), y = "Observed positive positions")
      emit_plot(pp, height = 4.5)
    }
    if (nrow(shown)) emit_table(shown, sprintf("posenrich/accumulation/%s/accumulation_%s_results.csv", dir, dir),
                                sci_cols = c("p", "q", "Hypergeometric p", "Hypergeometric q"))
  }
  cat("\n\nThe table lists genes above the expected count of the headline model, ordered by p and then by observed over expected. The published CSV holds every gene of U with the raw p and q of both models.\n\n")
}
```

# Level 2: terms that concentrate positive positions within genes {#level2}

Inside the genes that carry a term, do the positive positions fall in the term more often than in the rest of the same gene? The statistic of a term sums, over its eligible genes, the observed positive positions inside the term minus those expected if the positives of the gene were spread evenly. It is calibrated with the null cycles (p = (1 + cycles with a statistic at least the observed one) / (N + 1); q is BH within each layer). The definition of the statistic and of eligibility is in the appendix (Methods).

```{r level2, results='asis'}
if (is.null(res)) {
  unavailable("Level 2", "`within_gene_results.tsv` was not found: the module ran without level 2 or the engine did not finish.")
} else {
  cat(sprintf("%s terms were evaluated against %s null cycles (smallest attainable p = 1 / (N + 1) = %s). Terms with status `below_min_genes` have within-gene contrasts in fewer than %s source-covered genes and `not_identifiable` terms have no eligible gene: neither has a p or q (they are listed in the appendix).\n\n",
              fmt_int(nrow(res)), fmt_int(n_cycles), if (is.na(p_floor)) "NA" else format(p_floor, digits = 3), min_genes))
  by_coll <- res %>% group_by(Layer = collection_id) %>%
    summarise(Terms = n(), Tested = sum(status == "tested"), `Below minimum genes` = sum(status == "below_min_genes"),
              `Not identifiable` = sum(status == "not_identifiable"),
              `Smallest p` = if (any(!is.na(p))) min(p, na.rm = TRUE) else NA, .groups = "drop")
  for (i in seq_along(bh_levels)) by_coll[[paste0("Terms with ", bh_labels[i])]] <- vapply(by_coll$Layer,
    function(ly) sum(!is.na(res$q) & res$collection_id == ly & res$q < bh_levels[i]), 1L)
  cat(sprintf("**Summary by layer** (BH levels: %s)\n\n", paste(bh_labels, collapse = ", ")))
  report_emit(report_table(by_coll, sci_cols = "Smallest p"))

  tt <- res %>% filter(status == "tested") %>% arrange(p, desc(statistic))
  cat("\n\n## Terms {.tabset}\n\n### Tested terms\n\n")
  cat("Ordered by p. Frequency is the proportion of positive positions among the positions of U of the eligible genes inside the term, against the same proportion in the rest of those genes. Intensity is the difference between the mean score of the positive positions inside the term and outside it. The p-values do not separate frequency from intensity; the two effect sizes are descriptive and carry no p-value.\n\n")
  if (nrow(tt)) emit_table(term_tbl %>% filter(Status == "tested") %>% select(-Status, -`Genes with members in U`), "posenrich/within_gene/within_gene_results.tsv", sci_cols = c("p", "q"))
  else cat("No term was tested.\n\n")

  cat("\n### Effect against significance\n\n")
  if (nrow(tt)) {
    cat("Each dot is a tested term. The horizontal axis is the difference between the proportion of positive positions inside the term and in the rest of its eligible genes; the dotted line is the smallest attainable p. Colours are the BH class of the term (grey: not below the loosest level).\n\n")
    pv <- ggplot(tt, aes(frequency_difference, -log10(p), colour = bh_factor(q), size = n_genes_eligible)) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(p_floor), linetype = "dotted", colour = "grey50") +
      geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey80") +
      geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
      scale_size_area(max_size = 5, name = "Eligible genes") +
      scale_colour_manual(values = bh_colours, drop = FALSE, name = "BH class") +
      labs(x = "Frequency difference (term minus rest of its genes)", y = expression(-log[10]~p))
    emit_plot(pv, height = 5)
  } else cat("No term was tested.\n\n")

  cat("\n### Leading terms\n\n")
  if (nrow(tt)) {
    top <- tt %>% head(25) %>% mutate(.label = factor(paste0(collection_id, ": ", term_id), levels = rev(paste0(collection_id, ": ", term_id))))
    cat("The 25 terms with the smallest p. Size is the number of eligible genes; the horizontal axis is the observed minus the expected positive positions inside the term, summed over its eligible genes.\n\n")
    pt <- ggplot(top, aes(statistic, .label, colour = pmin(-log10(q), 4), size = n_genes_eligible)) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey80") + geom_point() +
      scale_colour_gradient(low = "#9ecae1", high = "#b2182b", name = expression(-log[10]~q~"(capped at 4)")) +
      scale_size_area(max_size = 6, name = "Eligible genes") +
      labs(x = "Observed minus expected positive positions", y = NULL)
    emit_plot(pt, height = max(4, 2 + 0.28 * nrow(top)))
  } else cat("No term was tested.\n\n")

  cat("\n### Genes behind the leading terms\n\n")
  if (is.null(wg_by_gene)) {
    unavailable("Per-gene table", "`within_gene_by_gene.tsv` was not found.")
  } else {
    top_terms <- ordered %>% filter(status == "tested") %>% head(as.integer(params$detail_terms)) %>% select(collection_id, term_id)
    if (nrow(top_terms)) {
      plot_terms <- top_terms %>% head(8)
      pg <- wg_by_gene %>% semi_join(plot_terms, by = c("collection_id", "term_id")) %>% filter(eligible == 1L, positives_gene > 0) %>%
        mutate(.term = paste0(collection_id, ": ", term_id)) %>% group_by(.term) %>% arrange(desc(abs(residual))) %>% slice_head(n = 12) %>% ungroup()
      if (nrow(pg)) {
        cat("For the 8 terms with the smallest p, the residual r~g~ of the genes with the largest absolute residual (observed minus expected positive positions inside the term). Positive bars push the term up.\n\n")
        ppg <- ggplot(pg, aes(residual, reorder(gene, residual), fill = residual > 0)) + geom_col() +
          facet_wrap(~.term, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
          scale_fill_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "#b2182b", `FALSE` = "#2166ac"), guide = "none") +
          labs(x = "Residual (observed minus expected positive positions in the term)", y = NULL) + theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7))
        emit_plot(ppg, height = 2 + 1.6 * ceiling(length(unique(pg$.term)) / 2))
      }
      cat(sprintf("\n**Genes of the leading terms** (up to %s terms; eligible and excluded, with the reason). Filter the Term column to read one term. The complete table is `posenrich/within_gene/within_gene_by_gene.tsv`.\n\n",
                  nrow(top_terms)))
      detail <- wg_by_gene %>% semi_join(top_terms, by = c("collection_id", "term_id")) %>%
        mutate(excluded_reason = ifelse(is.na(excluded_reason) | excluded_reason == "", "eligible",
                                        c(no_nonmembers = "excluded: no positions outside the term", term_below_min_genes = "excluded: term below the minimum of genes")[excluded_reason])) %>%
        transmute(Layer = collection_id, Term = term_id, Gene = gene, `Positions in gene` = n_positions_gene,
                  `Positions in term` = n_members, `Positive positions in gene` = positives_gene,
                  `Positive positions in term` = positives_members, `Expected in term` = expected_members,
                  Residual = residual, Eligibility = excluded_reason)
      emit_table(detail, "posenrich/within_gene/within_gene_by_gene.tsv")
    } else cat("No term has an identifiable statistic.\n\n")
  }
}
```

# Overlaps and proximity {#proximity}

Two separate contracts: **protein** distance in reference residues (0 inside a region), and **genomic** distance in nucleotides on the same chromosome (0 on coincidence). Proteins without a comparable reference have no distance and count as missing coverage. Radii are fixed before looking at the data and no p-value is reported. An **overlap** is a positive position that is itself a member of the term (identity of the position). A **near position** is a different positive position within the largest radius of a member of the term in the same protein, listed with the member it is closest to. Site lists (`custom`) come first in the tables.

```{r proximity, results='asis'}
if (is.null(prox_p) && is.null(prox_g)) {
  unavailable("Proximity", "No summary table was found in the proximity directory.")
} else {
  if (length(radii)) cat(sprintf("Radii: %s residues; positions within %s residues of a member count as near.\n\n", paste(radii, collapse = ", "), near_radius))
  cat("## Proximity {.tabset}\n\n")
  if (!is.null(prox_hits) && !is.null(prox_p)) {
    cat("### Overview by term\n\n")
    overview <- prox_p %>% left_join(prox_counts, by = c("collection_id", "term_id")) %>%
      mutate(across(c(`Overlaps (exact identity)`, `Near positions`, `Genes with an overlap`, `Genes with a near position`), ~ tidyr::replace_na(.x, 0L))) %>%
      arrange(coll_rank(collection_id), desc(`Overlaps (exact identity)`), desc(`Near positions`)) %>%
      transmute(Layer = collection_id, Term = term_id, `Positions evaluated` = n_positions_evaluated,
                `Genes with sites` = n_genes_with_sites, `Median distance` = median_distance,
                `Overlaps (exact identity)`, `Near positions`, `Genes with an overlap`, `Genes with a near position`)
    cat("Protein; positions evaluated are the positive positions of genes that carry the term.\n\n")
    emit_table(overview, "posenrich/proximity/proximity_protein_summary.tsv")

    cat("\n\n### Overlaps (exact identity)\n\n")
    ov <- prox_hits %>% filter(relation == "overlap") %>% arrange(coll_rank(collection_id), collection_id, term_id, Gene, Position) %>%
      transmute(Layer = collection_id, Term = term_id, Gene, Position, `Residue` = hg38_aa_pos, `In region` = in_region, Score = CAAS_score)
    cat(sprintf("%s positive positions coincide with a member of a term (counted once per term).\n\n", fmt_int(nrow(ov))))
    if (nrow(ov)) emit_table(ov, "posenrich/proximity/proximity_protein_hits.tsv")
    cat("\n\n### Near positions\n\n")
    nr <- prox_hits %>% filter(relation == "near") %>% arrange(coll_rank(collection_id), collection_id, term_id, distance_residues, Gene, Position) %>%
      transmute(Layer = collection_id, Term = term_id, Gene, Position, `Residue` = hg38_aa_pos,
                `Distance (residues)` = distance_residues, `Closest member (position)` = nearest_site_position,
                `Closest member (residue)` = nearest_site_residue, Score = CAAS_score)
    cat(sprintf("%s positive positions lie within %s residues of a member without being one.\n\n", fmt_int(nrow(nr)), near_radius))
    if (nrow(nr)) emit_table(nr, "posenrich/proximity/proximity_protein_hits.tsv")
    if (!is.null(prox_gene)) {
      cat("\n\n### By gene\n\n")
      bg <- prox_gene %>% filter(n_overlaps > 0 | n_near > 0) %>% arrange(coll_rank(collection_id), collection_id, term_id, desc(n_overlaps), desc(n_near), Gene) %>%
        transmute(Layer = collection_id, Term = term_id, Gene, `Members of the term in the gene` = n_term_positions_in_gene,
                  `Positive positions measured` = n_detections_measured, Overlaps = n_overlaps, `Near positions` = n_near,
                  `Closest distance (residues)` = min_distance_residues)
      cat("Genes with at least one overlap or near position, per term.\n\n")
      emit_table(bg, "posenrich/proximity/proximity_protein_by_gene.tsv")
    }
  } else if (!is.null(prox_p)) {
    cat("### Overview by term\n\nThe overlap and near-position lists were not found.\n\n")
    emit_table(prox_p %>% transmute(Layer = collection_id, Term = term_id, `Positions evaluated` = n_positions_evaluated,
        `Median distance` = median_distance, `Within 0` = prop_within_0), "posenrich/proximity/proximity_protein_summary.tsv")
  }

  dist_file <- component_file(params$proximity_dir, "proximity_protein_distances.tsv")
  if (file.exists(dist_file) && !is.null(prox_p) && any(prox_p$collection_id == "custom")) {
    dd <- read_tsv(dist_file, show_col_types = FALSE,
                   col_types = cols_only(collection_id = col_character(), term_id = col_character(),
                                         distance_residues = col_double(), status = col_character())) %>%
      filter(collection_id == "custom", status == "measured", !is.na(distance_residues))
    if (nrow(dd)) {
      cat("\n\n### Distance to site lists\n\n")
      cat("Cumulative proportion of positive positions within a distance of the closest member of each site list; dotted lines mark the radii. Without a control (the distance expected for positions placed at random in the same proteins) a curve only describes the data.\n\n")
      xmax <- max(100, 5 * near_radius)
      pe <- ggplot(dd, aes(distance_residues, colour = term_id)) + stat_ecdf(geom = "step") +
        geom_vline(xintercept = radii, linetype = "dotted", colour = "grey60") +
        coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, xmax)) +
        labs(x = "Distance to the closest member (residues)", y = "Cumulative proportion of positions", colour = "Site list") +
        theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.direction = "vertical")
      emit_plot(pe, height = 4.5)
    }
  }
  if (!is.null(prox_g)) {
    cat("\n\n### Genomic proximity\n\n")
    cat("Nucleotides; `Within r` counts positions at most r nucleotides away.\n\n")
    emit_table(prox_g %>% transmute(Layer = collection_id, Term = term_id,
        `Positions evaluated` = n_positions_evaluated, `Positions with a distance` = n_positions_measured,
        `Median distance` = median_distance, `Genes with sites` = n_genes_with_sites,
        `Within 0` = prop_within_0, `Within 5` = prop_within_5, `Within 10` = prop_within_10),
      "posenrich/proximity/proximity_genomic_summary.tsv")
  }
}
```

# By term {#termview}

One row per term of every layer: how many of its positions are positive, what level 2 says about it and how many positive positions overlap it or lie near it. Ordered by q, then p, then positive positions. A blank cell means that the analysis did not evaluate the term (for example, a term in fewer than the minimum of genes has no p or q).

```{r termview, results='asis'}
if (is.null(term_view)) unavailable("Term view", "`collection_summary.tsv` was not found in the characterization directory.") else
  emit_table(term_view, "posenrich/characterization/collection_summary.tsv", sci_cols = c("p", "q"))
```

# Characterization of the positive positions {#characterization}

Counts of positive positions by layer, with their denominators. No test is applied: an annotation does not gain significance by annotating. The counts by term are in the table above.

```{r characterization, results='asis'}
if (is.null(coll_sum)) {
  unavailable("Characterization", "`collection_summary.tsv` was not found in the characterization directory.")
} else {
  by_layer <- coll_sum %>% group_by(Layer = collection_id) %>%
    summarise(Terms = n(), `Annotated positions (summed over terms)` = sum(n_members),
              `Positive positions (summed over terms)` = sum(n_members_positive),
              `Genes (max over terms)` = max(n_genes), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(`Positive / annotated` = ifelse(`Annotated positions (summed over terms)` > 0,
                                           `Positive positions (summed over terms)` / `Annotated positions (summed over terms)`, NA))
  cat("**By layer.** A position that belongs to several terms is counted once per term.\n\n")
  report_emit(report_table(by_layer))
  pl <- by_layer %>% mutate(Layer = reorder(Layer, `Positive positions (summed over terms)`))
  cat("\n")
  emit_plot(ggplot(pl, aes(`Positive positions (summed over terms)`, Layer)) + geom_col(fill = "#2166ac") +
              geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * `Positive / annotated`)), hjust = -0.1, size = 3) +
              scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.2))) +
              labs(x = "Positive positions (summed over terms; label: share of the annotated positions)", y = NULL),
            height = max(3, 1 + 0.35 * nrow(pl)))
}
if (!is.null(rank_sum)) {
  cat("\n**Distribution of the canonical score of the positive positions** by direction.\n\n")
  rk <- rank_sum %>% select(Direction = ranking, Positions = n_positions, `Scored positions` = n_scored,
                            Minimum = min, `25th percentile` = q25, Median = median, `75th percentile` = q75, Maximum = max,
                            `Nominal p` = n_nominal, starts_with("n_bh_"), `Without p` = n_p_unavailable) %>%
    rename_with(~ sub("^n_bh_", "BH q < ", .x), starts_with("BH q") | starts_with("n_bh_"))
  report_emit(report_table(rk))
}
```

# Appendix {#appendix .tabset}

## Universe and coverage

The universe U is the intersection of declared tested alignment positions and the cleaned gene background. Observed and null detections annotate this fixed opportunity; neither selects its members. Tested positions without a detection remain in U. An observed position outside U is an input incompatibility. Valid silent cycles count in the null denominator.

```{r universe, results='asis'}
if (is.null(universe)) {
  unavailable("Universe", "`universe.tsv.gz` was not found in the published universe directory.")
} else {
  n_pos <- sum(universe$observed_positive)
  n_top <- sum(universe$observed_top)
  n_bot <- sum(universe$observed_bottom)
  n_both <- sum(universe$observed_top == 1L & universe$observed_bottom == 1L)
  m <- universe_manifest$metrics
  n_list <- if (!is.null(m$n_genes)) m$n_genes else NA
  n_genes_u <- length(unique(universe$gene))
  rows <- data.frame(
    Quantity = c("Positions in U", "Genes in the gene list", "Genes with at least one position in U",
                 "Observed positive positions (either side)", "Positive on the top side", "Positive on the bottom side",
                 "Positive on both sides", "Positions of U that the null scores in no cycle",
                 "Observed positives outside the tested positions"),
    Count = c(n_u, n_list, n_genes_u, n_pos, n_top, n_bot, n_both, sum(universe$nd == 0L),
              if (is.null(m$n_observed_outside_tested)) NA else m$n_observed_outside_tested),
    Denominator = c(NA, NA, n_list, n_u, n_u, n_u, n_pos, n_u, n_pos),
    Denominator_is = c("", "", "genes in the gene list", "positions in U", "positions in U", "positions in U",
                       "observed positive positions", "positions in U", "observed positive positions"),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  rows$Proportion <- ifelse(is.na(rows$Denominator) | rows$Denominator == 0, NA, rows$Count / rows$Denominator)
  names(rows) <- c("Quantity", "Count", "Denominator", "Denominator is", "Proportion")
  report_emit(report_table(rows))
  cat(sprintf("\nThe base rate of positive positions in U is %s (%s of %s). The tested-position set was %s.\n\n",
              fmt_prop(n_pos / n_u), fmt_int(n_pos), fmt_int(n_u),
              switch(if (is.null(m$tested_set)) "unknown" else m$tested_set,
                     used = "used as the fixed opportunity",
                     unknown = "not recorded", m$tested_set)))
  nd_q <- if (nrow(universe)) quantile(universe$nd, c(0.05, 0.5, 0.95)) else rep(NA_real_,3)
  cat(sprintf("Detectability varies across U: the number of null cycles that score a position has median %s and 5th to 95th percentile %s to %s.\n\n",
              fmt_int(nd_q[2]), fmt_int(nd_q[1]), fmt_int(nd_q[3])))
  pn <- ggplot(universe, aes(nd + 1)) + geom_histogram(bins = 60, fill = "#2166ac") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = nd_q[2] + 1, linetype = "dashed", colour = "#b2182b") + scale_x_log10() +
    labs(x = "Null cycles that score the position, nd + 1 (log scale; dashed line: median)", y = "Positions of U")
  emit_plot(pn, height = 3.5)
}
if (!is.null(states_tbl)) {
  ev <- states_tbl %>% filter(!grepl("^coverage:", evaluation_status)) %>%
    transmute(`Evaluation status` = evaluation_status, Positions = n_positions, Proportion = proportion, Denominator = denominator)
  cov <- states_tbl %>% filter(grepl("^coverage:", evaluation_status)) %>%
    transmute(Metric = sub("^coverage:", "", evaluation_status), Value = n_positions)
  if (nrow(ev)) {
    cat("**Evaluation states of the registry positions** (denominator: positions of the registry)\n\n")
    report_emit(report_table(ev))
  }
  if (nrow(cov)) {
    cat("\n**Registry coverage**\n\n")
    report_emit(report_table(cov))
  }
}
```

## BH thresholds

Number of hits at each BH level (cumulative); missing q-values are excluded. The hypergeometric model of level 1 is a reference (uniform opportunity over U, conditioned on the observed total) and its q-values form a separate family from the empirical ones.

```{r bh, results='asis'}
if (length(acc_present)) {
  bh_l1 <- do.call(rbind, lapply(acc_present, function(dir) {
    d <- level1[[dir]]
    do.call(rbind, lapply(c("Empirical", "Hypergeometric"), function(model) {
      q <- if (model == "Empirical") d$EmpiricalQ else d$QValue
      data.frame(Direction = dir, Model = model, `BH q <` = bh_levels,
                 `q available` = sum(is.finite(q)), Hits = bh_hits(q), check.names = FALSE)
    }))
  }))
  cat("**Level 1, by direction and model**\n\n")
  report_emit(report_table(bh_l1))
}
if (!is.null(res)) {
  bh_l2 <- res %>% group_by(Layer = collection_id) %>% group_modify(~ tibble(
    `BH q <` = bh_levels,
    `q available` = sum(is.finite(.x$q)), Hits = bh_hits(.x$q))) %>% ungroup()
  cat("\n\n**Level 2, by layer**\n\n")
  report_emit(report_table(bh_l2))
}
if (!length(acc_present) && is.null(res)) cat("Neither level ran.\n\n")
```

```{r not-tested, results='asis'}
if (is.null(term_tbl)) unavailable("Terms not tested", "Level 2 results are not available.") else {
  cat("Terms with status `below_min_genes` or `not_identifiable`, with the number of genes of U that carry them.\n\n")
  emit_table(term_tbl %>% filter(Status != "tested") %>% select(Layer, Term, Status, `Genes with members in U`, `Genes eligible`),
             "posenrich/within_gene/within_gene_results.tsv")
}
```

## Methods

```{r methods, results='asis'}
min_genes_m <- wg_manifest$parameters$min_genes
cat(sprintf("**BH levels:** %s (producer p/q are preserved; the class of a q is the strictest level it is below).\n\n", paste(bh_levels, collapse = ", ")))
cat(paste0(
  "- **Estimand.** Positive positions of the canonical score. A position that is not detected is never imputed as a negative outside U.\n",
  "- **Universe.** U is fixed by tested positions and the cleaned background, independently of observed/null detections.\n",
  "- **Calibration.** Levels 1 and 2 are calibrated with the null cycles (",
  if (is.na(n_cycles)) "number not recorded" else paste0(fmt_int(n_cycles), " in this run"),
  "), which carry the detectability of each position, the co-occurrence of detections within a gene and the gene filter of the null. Total detections and gene filtering may vary by cycle.\n",
  "- **Level 1.** Upper-tail count test per gene over all valid cycles: `(1 + cycles with count >= observed) / (N + 1)`. Separate fixed BH families for all, top and bottom include genes with no observed positives. The hypergeometric model `Hyper(M, n_g, K)` allocates the K observed detections uniformly without replacement over U; it is a reference, not calibrated with the null.\n",
  "- **Level 2.** For a term S and a gene g with positions inside and outside S, the residual is r~g~ = (positive positions of g in S) - k~g~ m~g~ / n~g~, where k~g~ is the number of positive positions of g, n~g~ its positions in U covered by the annotation source and m~g~ those in S. The statistic of the term is the sum of r~g~ over its eligible genes. Each residual is centered using its own cycle margins (this is not exact conditioning on the observed counts) and genes with more detections can contribute larger residuals. Positions are weighted equally (a position is positive or not); the score enters only the descriptive intensity. A gene is eligible when it has members and non-members in U.\n",
  "- **Terms in one gene.** A term needs members in at least ",
  if (is.null(min_genes_m)) "a minimum number of" else min_genes_m,
  " source-covered genes supplying both members and nonmembers. The rule depends on annotation, coverage and U only, never on the observed positives: a term in one gene is a test inside that gene, not a concentration across genes.\n",
  "- **Rankings.** Level 2 deliberately pools sides by their best score. Level 1 reports separate all/top/bottom analyses using the corresponding observed and null directions.\n",
  "- **Resolution.** The attainable p-value resolution is 1/(N+1).\n",
  "- **Overlaps and proximity.** Descriptive; the positions queried are the positive ones, an overlap is identity of the position and no control of distances is applied.\n"))
cat("\n**Symbols.** U: universe of tested positions; M: positions in U; K: observed positive positions; n~g~: positions of gene g in U; nd: null cycles that score a position; N: null cycles; layer: source of annotation; term: one set of positions of a layer.\n\n")
if (!is.null(wg_manifest$parameters)) {
  p <- wg_manifest$parameters
  cat("\n**Level 2 parameters.**\n\n")
  report_emit(report_table(data.frame(
    Parameter = c("Layers", "Minimum genes per term", "Null cycles", "Null blocks", "Terms", "Term-gene pairs", "Eligible pairs"),
    Value = c(if (is.null(p$collections)) "informative layers" else paste(unlist(p$collections), collapse = ", "),
              as.character(p$min_genes), as.character(n_cycles),
              as.character(wg_manifest$counts$n_blocks), as.character(wg_manifest$counts$n_terms),
              as.character(wg_manifest$counts$n_pairs), as.character(wg_manifest$counts$n_pairs_eligible)),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE)))
}
```

**Provenance.** The tables come from `posenrich/universe`, `posenrich/registry`, `posenrich/characterization`, `posenrich/accumulation`, `posenrich/within_gene` and `posenrich/proximity`; each component writes a manifest with the hashes of its inputs. Pfam, UCR and selection layers derive from related evolutionary analyses and are not independent external validation.
